events.what: Dutour Sikirić and van Woerden complete Voronoi's algorithm in dimension 9, enumerating all 2,237,251,040 perfect lattices, and derive gamma_9 = 2

judgement.doubts: The bullet asks for the Hermite constants in every dimension other than 1-8 and 24. Settling one dimension (9) is a case, so the status is partial however it is verified, and the earlier correction from claimed to partial was right. The computation is a 2.2-billion-lattice enumeration: it is deterministic and its data are on Zenodo, but it is too large to count as simply checkable, and the record shows no independent rerun. The February 2026 revision is not a new event. Methods are classical (Voronoi, Nauty/Traces, PPL, LRS), with no AI involved.
